rule_outs: Dwelling 1 m from the best section
summary: Narrow lane with homes 1-8 m from the kerb and No Stopping signs.
reasons: Homes 1-8 m away along the south kerb
No Stopping and No Parking Any Time signs

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings sit 1-8 m from the kerb at 0-30 m, 58 m, 87 m and 104 m; no stretch has bush or open ground behind it.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow lane under trees with fences and house frontages at the edge; no room to pull fully off.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential lane, with a busier road at the far end.
drivers.convention: Only a car or two parked at the start; signs at the Indooroopilly Road end ban stopping and parking.

flags: No Stopping Any Time and No Parking Any Time signs near the far end
Dwellings under 10 m from the kerb
Steep in places: mean 6.7%, max 28.7% from the DEM
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over much of the kerb; houses to the south.
